# City of Euclid

> Municipal government website for Euclid, Ohio providing access to city services, council information, permits, tax filing, and citizen request systems.

City of Euclid serves as the official online hub for municipal services in Euclid, Ohio. The site provides comprehensive access to city departments, government operations, public records, and community services including emergency response, building permits, income tax filing, and citizen reporting tools.

## Key Topics

- City of Euclid
- Euclid City Council
- Municipal Services
- Public Records
- City Departments
- Citizen Requests
- Building Permits
- City Income Tax

- Employment Opportunities

- Ordinances and Legislation
- Community Television
- Pothole Reporting
- Mayor's Office

## City Government & Leadership

- [Home](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov): City of Euclid homepage with municipal services, announcements, and quick links
- [City Council](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/city-council): Euclid City Council meeting schedules, goals, and ward redistricting information
- [City Departments](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/city-departments): Directory of City of Euclid departments and contact information
- [Mayor's Office](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/mayors-office): Mayor Kirsten Holzheimer Gail's office contact and city leadership information
- [Minutes/Agendas](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/minutes/agendas): City council meeting minutes, agendas, and municipal committee documents

## Municipal Services & Permits

- [Building and Housing](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/building): Building permits, housing inspections, and property maintenance services
- [City Income Tax](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/city-income-tax): City income tax filing requirements, deadlines, and RITA partnership information
- [Finance](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/finance): Finance Department contact and municipal financial records management
- [Fire](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/fire): Euclid Fire Department emergency services, EMS, and fire safety information
- [Law](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/law): Law Department, prosecutors office, and municipal legal services contact

## Citizen Services & Support

- [Citizen Requests - Report Pothole, Water Main Break](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/citizen-requests): Report potholes, water main breaks, and other service requests to City of Euclid
- [Public Records Requests](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/public-records-requests): Process for requesting public records under Ohio Revised Code 149.43
- [Euclid Information Lookup](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/euclid-information-lookup): Directory and lookup tool for Euclid municipal services and government contacts
- [Council FAQs](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/council-faqs): Frequently asked questions about Euclid City Council and government

## Legislation & Records

- [Council Legislation](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/legislation): Euclid ordinances, legislation database, and council records archive

## Employment & Human Resources

- [Job Opportunities](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/Job_Opportunities): City of Euclid employment opportunities and municipal job listings
- [Human Resources](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/human-resources): Human Resources Department employment opportunities and civil service information

## Community Resources

- [Community Television (ECTV)](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/newpage354284a7): Euclid Community Television broadcasts and local media submission information
- [Euclid Pet Pals](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/euclid-pet-pals): Euclid Pet Pals and Animal Shelter volunteer and adoption information
- [History](https://www.cityofeuclid.gov/history): City of Euclid history from founding through early industries and development
